name: HtrA serine peptidase 1

function.text: HTRA1 encodes serine protease HTRA1. Annotated molecular activities include serine-type endopeptidase activity and serine-type peptidase activity. It participates in proteolysis and programmed cell death.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to cerebral arteriopathy, autosomal recessive, with subcortical infarcts and leukoencephalopathy 2 (autosomal recessive); cerebral arteriopathy, autosomal dominant, with subcortical infarcts and leukoencephalopathy, type 2 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: The gene appears in specialty educational coverage, but a disease-specific somatic driver relationship has not been assigned in this draft; expression-marker or assay-context mentions are not mutation evidence.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from Ambry Genetics. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Genomics England PanelApp. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
